# Magma lint

> Scope: checking the code you write against the installed Magma.

The rules make the prose of these guides executable.

## Set it up

Nothing to install from Magma.

### HTML and web components

Add the HTML block.

### React

Add the React block.

## Run it after writing

Run ESLint and Stylelint after every change.

## Rules

### no-false-boolean

A boolean prop is turned off by removing its attribute.
